understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while avoiding spikes ('u'/'v'); reaching '+' completes the level and ultimately wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT to shift one tile horizontally, then gravity automatically carries the character in the current gravity direction until landing on a solid/support tile ('o','m','w'), hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. CLICK can be used on breakable/clickable blocks ('x') at a specified [x,y] to remove them and open a fall path; clicks do not move the player. Landing on spikes ends the attempt immediately. UNDO reverts the previous action. Levels allow 2 attempts with a 50-turn limit per attempt, and planning uses the provided landing previews to avoid hazards and find passages to new sections.
